lines.text: God tells Moses to bring Aaron and his four sons to serve as priests, with holy garments made by skilled craftsmen.
Two onyx stones engraved with the names of the sons of Israel are fastened on the ephod's shoulder pieces.
The square breastpiece has four rows of gemstones, and each of the twelve stones is engraved with a tribe's name.
Aaron carries the names of the sons of Israel and the Urim and Thummim on his shoulders before the LORD.
Gold bells alternate with pomegranates on the robe's hem, and a gold plate reading HOLY TO THE LORD sits on Aaron's sash.
